result.citation: Cella v. Attorney General, SJC-13893 (Mass. June 23, 2026)
result.citation_basis: Cella v. Attorney General, SJC-13893: O101, D059; (Mass. June 23, 2026): O101 (date also D059)
result.note: Adopted the lawyer's form, which O101 and D059 support, citing the case itself instead of the petition name; the Supreme Judicial Court held that Initiative Petition 25-21 (statewide rent control) relates to religion under Article 48 and barred it from the November 2026 ballot, so it creates no rent cap.
